name: Basket Constituents 3
definition: Choice between ISIN and an alternative format for the identification of a financial instrument. ISIN is the preferred format.

InstrumentIdentification.name: Instrument Identification
InstrumentIdentification.definition: Proprietary identification of a security assigned by an institution or organisation.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Indicates the number of units of a particular constituent in a custom basket.

UnitOfMeasure.name: Unit Of Measure
UnitOfMeasure.definition: Specifies the unit of measure in which the number of units of a particular custom basket constituent is expressed.
